detail: The run was parked at ManagerApproval (Running, 1 completed step(s)). The terminate was acknowledged (1 acknowledgement(s)) and the runtime status sampled every 3s afterwards was: Running Running Running Running Running, ending Running. A later answer was delivered by a live worker ('delivered' printed 0 time(s)); the run ended Terminated with history: OrchestratorStarted > ExecutionStarted > TaskScheduled > OrchestratorStarted > TaskCompleted > OrchestratorStarted > ExecutionTerminated > EventRaised > ExecutionCompleted > TaskScheduled — 1 completed step(s) before the answer and 1 after, and an ExecutionTerminated in the history. So the orchestration stopped and the answer did not run the step after the port. Scope: this column has no separate child work to cancel — the ports live inside one orchestration — so 'children cancelled' is not observable here and is not claimed.
